title: Motion / Gravity and weight

location.series: Elvis Dinh / Instagram brand design system / project year 2022

slide_intent: Make graphic elements respond to implied physical forces so movement has character.
strategic_value: A familiar heart and account label can carry Instagram recognition through changes in scale and position.
demonstration: A dark account label and a gradient heart enter, tilt and change position against white; the heart shifts shape and color as the sequence progresses.
practical_value: Use the example to compare perceived weight and movement without extracting an unsupported easing formula.

content_islands.name: Account label
content_islands.spec: Introduce the dark name label as a separate moving object.

content_islands.name: Heart object
content_islands.spec: Give the larger gradient heart room to move and tilt against white.

reference_purposes.Intent: The accompanying section attributes motion inspiration to users’ movements through the app.
reference_purposes.Expression: The sequence gives the label and heart a sense of gravity and weight.
